info.title: EduSphere Backend API
info.description:
RESTful API documentation for the EduSphere E-Learning & Assessment Platform.

The specification is assembled at runtime by `swagger-jsdoc` from route annotations (TRD §3.3).

HealthStatus.description: Flat, deliberately not wrapped in the { status, message, data } envelope of apidoc §1. `status: "ok"` is the literal string asserted by AC-10 and read by the Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK; enveloping it breaks both.

database.description: PostgreSQL reachability, proven by a query rather than by connection state.

redis.description: Redis reachability, proven by a PING rather than by connection state.

AuthUser.description: The `data.user` shape of apidoc §8.2. Never carries passwordHash — it is not selected from PostgreSQL at all outside login().

AuthProfile.description: AuthUser plus the columns an account may read about itself (GET /auth/me). isBanned and deletedAt are omitted — the auth guard has already refused every caller for whom either is set.

AuthSession.description: What register and login return. The 7-day refresh token is NOT here — it is delivered as an HttpOnly cookie so that script cannot read it (TRD §7.1).

accessToken.description: Bearer token, 15-minute lifetime, signed with JWT_SECRET.

servers.description: Health probes sit outside the /api/v1 prefix, so this path overrides the root server URL.

get.description: Reports backend, PostgreSQL, and Redis connectivity. Public and exempt from rate limiting so load balancers and container orchestrators are never throttled out of their own probe (apidoc §4, §8.1).

200.description: Server and both dependencies are reachable.

503.description: At least one dependency is unreachable.

200.description: A list of courses for the subject

post.description: Creates a new quiz. Instructors can only create quizzes for their own courses.

get.description: Fetch quiz metadata and questions. Strips correctAnswerIndex for students.

put.description: Updates a quiz. Instructors can only update their own quizzes.

delete.description: Deletes a quiz. Returns 409 if attempts exist, overridable with ?force=true.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force deletion of quiz with attempts

409.description: Cannot delete quiz with existing attempts

get.description: Retrieve historical attempts for a quiz.

403.description: Forbidden (trying to read someone else's attempts)

post.description: Submit answers for grading. Enforces attempt caps.
Batch creates questions. Returns 409 if attempts exist.

409.description: Cannot add questions if attempts exist

put.description: Updates a question. Structural changes (options, correctAnswerIndex, type) return 409 if attempts exist.

409.description: Cannot change question structure if attempts exist

delete.description: Removes a question from a quiz. Returns 409 if attempts exist.

409.description: Cannot delete question if attempts exist

post.description: Marks a lesson as completed for the authenticated user and recalculates course progress.
Enrolls the authenticated user in the specified course. Requires a verified email.

404.description: Course not found or not published

422.description: Instructor cannot enroll in own course

get.description: Retrieves the lesson-by-lesson progress checklist for an enrollment.

patch.description: Sets the enrollment status to DROPPED, preserving progress but skipping studentCount decrements.

post.summary: Register a student or instructor account
post.description:
Creates the account, emails a verification token with a 24-hour TTL, and
returns a 15-minute access token. Opens no session: there is no refresh
cookie on this response, so a new account signs in to obtain one.

`role` accepts STUDENT and INSTRUCTOR only — ADMIN is refused by the
schema, so self-registration cannot mint an administrator.

password.description: At least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase and a digit; at most 72 bytes.

409.description: Email address already registered. Deliberately generic — it does not distinguish a duplicate from any other conflict.

422.description: Schema validation failed; `errors[]` carries one entry per field.

429.description: More than 5 requests in 15 minutes from this IP.

503.description: Redis unreachable, so the verification token could not be stored. The account is rolled back and no user is created.

post.summary: Authenticate credentials and open a session
post.description:
Returns an access token in the body and sets the 7-day refresh token as
`HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/v1/auth`.

An unverified address may sign in and browse; verification gates only
enrollment, course creation and quiz submission (TRD §6.1).

200.description: Authenticated. The refresh token is in the Set-Cookie header, not the body.

Set-Cookie.description: refreshToken=...; Max-Age=604800; Path=/api/v1/auth; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict

401.description: Unknown address or wrong password — one message for both, so this endpoint is not an account oracle.

403.description: Credentials valid but the account is banned or soft-deleted.

429.description: More than 5 requests in 15 minutes from this IP.

503.description: Redis unreachable, so the session could not be recorded. No tokens are issued.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh cookie and issue a fresh access token
post.description:
Reads the refresh token from the `HttpOnly` cookie — never from the body,
which must be empty — verifies its `session:<jti>` key still exists,
unlinks it, and issues a new pair.

Additionally requires that `Origin`, or `Referer` when `Origin` is absent,
match `CORS_ORIGIN` (TRD §7.1 CSRF Defense). A request carrying neither
header is not a browser and is allowed through.

parameters.name: refreshToken
parameters.description: Sent automatically by the browser; not readable from script.

200.description: Rotated. The previous refresh token is revoked and cannot be replayed.

Set-Cookie.description: The rotated refresh token, same attributes as login.

401.description: Cookie absent, malformed, expired, revoked, of the wrong token class, from an account since banned or soft-deleted, or presented from a foreign origin. One message for all of them.

422.description: A request body was sent. This endpoint takes none.

429.description: More than 5 requests in 15 minutes from this IP (apidoc §4).

503.description: Redis unreachable. Fails closed — a session that cannot be verified is not honoured.

post.description:
Idempotent: a token that arrives after the flag is already true earns the
same 200. Only the SHA-256 of the token is stored, so a Redis dump yields
no usable tokens.

token.description: The raw token from the emailed link — 64 lowercase hex characters.

400.description: Token unknown, already consumed, or expired.

422.description: The token is not the right shape to have been issued by this application.

429.description: More than 5 requests in 15 minutes from this IP.

503.description: Redis unreachable — verification fails closed rather than proceeding unverified.

post.description:
Returns an identical 200 whether or not an account exists for the address:
this endpoint is deliberately not an account-enumeration oracle (TRD §6.1).
The token has a 15-minute TTL and invalidates any previous one.

200.description: Accepted. Byte-identical for a known and an unknown address.

429.description: More than 5 requests in 15 minutes from this IP.

503.description: Redis unreachable, so no token could be stored.

post.summary: Set a new password using a reset token
post.description:
The token is consumed before the new password is accepted, so it is
single-use even if the update then fails. Revokes every session the
account had — a reset must log out an attacker already holding a refresh
token (TRD §6.1) — which is why the response tells the caller to sign in
again.

200.description: Password hash updated and all sessions revoked.

400.description: Token unknown, already consumed, or expired.

422.description: Schema validation failed — including a new password that does not meet the policy.

429.description: More than 5 requests in 15 minutes from this IP.

503.description: Redis unreachable — the reset fails closed.

post.description:
Unlinks `session:<jti>` and removes that jti from
`session:index:<userId>`, then clears the cookie with the same
Path=/api/v1/auth it was set with. Requires an Origin/Referer match
(TRD §7.1). Idempotent: logging out twice is a 200 both times.

200.description: Session revoked, or there was none to revoke.

401.description: No access token, or a foreign origin.

403.description: The account is banned or soft-deleted.

503.description: The authorization state could not be read.

get.summary: Read the authenticated account's own profile

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token.

403.description: The account is banned or soft-deleted.

404.description: The account was deleted while the access token was still valid.

503.description: The authorization state could not be read.

get.summary: Paginated search across all platform courses

patch.summary: Unpublish a violating course with a reason
Promote or change a user's role

409.description: Demoting an instructor who owns published courses

post.summary: Ban a user account and instantly revoke all active sessions

200.description: Sets isBanned = true and revokes sessions

get.summary: Query the governance and moderation audit trail
